title: Design and synthesis of 1-Phenyl-2-thioaryl-4-benzyl-5-methylimidazoles as dual STAT3/NF-kappaB inhibitors for triple-negative breast Cancer therapy.
authors: Abdellatef, Amira A; Al-Kubeisi, Ahmed K; Fahmy, Salwa M; Georghiou, Paris E; Loksha, Yasser M; Hayakawa, Yoshihiro; Beshay, Botros Y; Bekhit, Adnan A
one_liner_zh: 该文设计合成咪唑类小分子抑制剂靶向STAT3/NF-kappaB通路治疗三阴性乳腺癌，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题仅边缘相关。
abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) lacks targeted therapies due to the absence of hormone receptors. The oncogenic crosstalk between STAT3 and NF-kappaB pathways drives tumor proliferation, epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), metastasis, and therapeutic resistance, underscoring a critical need for novel dual inhibitors. Here, we report the rational design and synthesis of new 1-phenyl-2-thioaryl-4-benzyl-5-methylimidazole derivatives targeting this dual pathway axis. Optimized, metal-free S-alkylation reactions of imidazole-2-thione afforded twelve new analogs (5a,b, 6, 7a-g, 8a,b) in excellent yields. Their antiproliferative activity was evaluated in 4 T1 and MDA-MB-231 cells, while the mechanistic leads (5a,b and 8a,b) were assessed for specific STAT3/NF-kappaB inhibition using luciferase reporter assays together with migration and invasion assays. Structure-activity relationship (SAR) analysis identified the difluorobenzylthio derivative 5b as the optimal lead candidate. At a sub-cytotoxic concentration (10 muM), 5b exhibited potent and specific targeted blockade, suppressing NF-kappaB and STAT3 transcriptional activities by  approximately 80% and  approximately  60%, respectively. In contrast, structurally related analogs (5a, 8a, 8b) only exhibited inhibitory effects that were inextricably linked to severe cytotoxicity. Furthermore, 5b demonstrated robust antimetastatic efficacy at non-toxic doses, maintaining >91% wound persistence in 4 T1 cells at 24 h and markedly blocking Matrigel invasion. Molecular docking studies at the STAT3-SH2 domain corroborated the biological data, confirming that the flexibility of the thioether linkage in the 5a and 5b provided optimal binding energies compared to the more rigid or bulkier inactive analogs. This newly accessible imidazole class successfully establishes dual STAT3/NF-kappaB inhibition with direct antimetastatic efficacy, positioning 5b as a highly promising TNBC lead warranting further in vivo validation and clinical translation.
abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）因缺乏激素受体而无靶向治疗手段。STAT3与NF-kappaB通路之间的致癌性串扰驱动肿瘤增殖、上皮-间质转化（EMT）、转移及治疗耐药，凸显了对新型双重抑制剂的关键需求。在此，我们报告了针对该双重通路轴的新型1-苯基-2-硫代芳基-4-苄基-5-甲基咪唑衍生物的合理设计与合成。通过优化的无金属S-烷基化反应，以优异产率获得了十二种新类似物（5a,b、6、7a-g、8a,b）。在4 T1和MDA-MB-231细胞中评估了其抗增殖活性，同时使用荧光素酶报告基因实验以及迁移和侵袭实验评估了机制性先导化合物（5a,b和8a,b）对STAT3/NF-kappaB的特异性抑制。构效关系（SAR）分析确定二氟苄硫基衍生物5b为最优先导候选物。在亚细胞毒性浓度（10 μM）下，5b表现出强效且特异性的靶向阻断作用，分别抑制NF-kappaB和STAT3转录活性约80%和约60%。相比之下，结构相关类似物（5a、8a、8b）仅表现出与严重细胞毒性密不可分的抑制效应。此外，5b在无毒剂量下展现出稳健的抗转移功效，在24小时时于4 T1细胞中维持>91%的伤口愈合率，并显著阻断Matrigel侵袭。STAT3-SH2结构域的分子对接研究 corroborated 了生物学数据，确认5a和5b中硫醚键的柔性相较于更刚性或更庞大的非活性类似物提供了最佳结合能。这一新可及的咪唑类化合物成功建立了双重STAT3/NF-kappaB抑制及直接抗转移功效，将5b定位为极具前景的TNBC先导物，值得进一步体内验证和临床转化。
